_comment: CDC scenario FROM EMPTY: Db2 CDC over the ASN SQL-Replication CD tables the db2cdc system registers for every model table, asncap copying each change a moment after it commits; column names arrive upper-cased and are matched without case. The CD tables carry the rows an ON DELETE CASCADE takes but not an UPDATE that changes nothing: --cascades logged --noops unlogged. Db2 has no snapshot isolation, so an initial load under changes may load a change and replay it too. The model is installed and holds NO data when the stream starts, so everything it carries arrives as changes, from zero. STAGES: (1) domains -- create the db2cdc domain and install employeescdc, no create-data; (2) actions, tagged live -- `sentinel-data --key before-stream`, the one row the stream's initial load finds; (3) collections and (4) functions -- register db2cdc_initial_load (initial_load=True), which STARTS it: its load is the empty tables and that sentinel; (5) sentinel -- hold until before-stream arrives, so the load is done before any data exists; (6) actions, tagged live -- the seed (`create-data --size 1`, one transaction), one `modify-data --ops Mix --sets 10` pass, `sentinel-data --key after-changes`; (7) sentinel -- hold until after-changes arrives; (8) actions, tagged check -- scripts/verify_cdc_ops.py --start initial-load: the load holds the sentinel alone, and the seed and every change after it arrive one by one, in their transactions, nothing of audit; (9) monitor. Generated by gen_suites.py. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite cdc/db2cdc_from_empty --keep`.
